Sheet output: 5 panels, identical character across all of them.
monastic mountain cartographer, far-future, rendered as oil impasto concept art moodboard, a sun-bleached grade, washed linen

STAGE 2 — one panel per turnaround angle. Design lock text is restated in every panel prompt.

You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'monastic mountain cartographer, far-future, rendered as oil impasto'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a cinematic grade with a warm key and green-leaning ambient shadows. Lighting reference: a ring light on axis for flat, modern, shadowless coverage.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.

You are the character designer producing a turnaround sheet for the concept 'monastic mountain cartographer, far-future, rendered as oil impasto'.

PANEL. This branch renders the detail callouts: close-up inserts of hands, footwear and one signature prop.

DESIGN LOCK. The upstream art-direction synthesis fixes silhouette, palette, material story, age, build and every signature prop. Restate those specifics in your prompt and change nothing — a turnaround only works if all panels describe the identical character.

PRESENTATION. Neutral flat backdrop, even a large overhead octabox with a black flag killing the floor bounce, no dramatic set dressing — the sheet exists to read construction, not mood. Keep the figure fully inside frame with consistent scale across panels.

MATERIALS. Specify at least four materials by name — ribbed fluted glass, wet river stone and others — with their wear state, and grade to a sun-bleached grade with faded blacks and a green-yellow bias.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.
